head: qṣr 2 (< perhaps Arb. qṣr (IV): to make short, reduce, lessen; to desist, cease, refrain, abstain;)
notes: Yaʕni mʕawanno-wo ġalabe, u ʕamo ġalabe. U mede, d uṯe-wo meni, bi qabəliyayḏi, lə mqaṣarli qəm nošo 'I helped a lot, (helped) people a lot. Anything, that I could, that was in my power, I did not neglect (to do)' (QM 2148)
